eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Plumas, CA; at 12:04 PM on AUG 30, 2021 Effective until 12:04 PM AUG 31, 2021. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is a Mandatory Evacuation Order for the area of Lake Davis north to the intersection of Beckwourth Genesee Road and Bagley Pass Road North due to a wildfire. You should leave the area immediately. If you remain emergency personnel may not be able to help you. An evacuation center is set up in Portola. To view your evacuation zone go to community.zonehaven.com
